01 / The project

Built for a world that needs more energy, with less impact.

E-R brings solar photovoltaic panels and a wind turbine into one coordinated renewable energy system. By combining sources with different generation patterns, our graduation project explores how a hybrid setup can improve energy availability and make better use of the resources around it.

We’re bringing together electrical design, system monitoring, and thoughtful engineering to create a practical proof of concept—and documenting each step as we learn.

◎

Our objective

Study how solar and wind can complement one another to support more consistent clean power.

⌁

Our approach

Design, integrate, measure, and improve—grounding every iteration in engineering fundamentals.

A

Dual-source generation

Harness sunlight and moving air in a shared system.

B

Integrated monitoring

Track system behavior and evaluate performance.

C

Designed to evolve

Build a foundation for future tests and improvements.
